unit.why: A short anecdote, copied from the preface to Tehillah le-Moshe, in which the Yismach Moshe sends two messengers to the grave of R. Elimelech of Lizhensk to pray for his son and tells them how to alert the tsaddik's soul.
unit.boundary_note: Quoted excerpt appended ('אגב אעתיק לכאן') after the author's signature closing the previous division; next division is empty.

stories.start_quote: אגב אעתיק לכאן דבר יקר מהקדמת
stories.summary_en: The Yismach Moshe sends two worthy men to R. Elimelech's grave in Lizhensk to pray for his son. He tells them first to pledge a perutah of charity for whichever soul will run to tell R. Elimelech's soul that they have come, because the dead value such merit.
